info.desc: Year of the Snitch is the sixth studio album by experimental hip hop group Death Grips, released on June 22, 2018, through Third Worlds and Harvest Records. With the release of Steroids (Crouching Tiger Hidden Gabber Megamix), Death Grips announced they were "working on the new Death Grips album". The band has made apparent via social media that they had been working with ambitious collaborators for the creation of the project throughout the promotion of the album, including in-studio collaborations with Australian experimental musician Lucas Abela, New Zealand film director Andrew Adamson and Tool bassist Justin Chancellor. podcast.body: This album, launched progressively over two months, generated immense expectation, as is typical for any Dead Grips release. It is seen as a return to the band's roots, satisfying listeners who may not have been fully convinced by their more recent stages, such as *Buttonlesspeak*. The album's sound is reminiscent of their early work, incorporating samples and fragments from *Ismilitar* and *Monistor*. While not a radical musical revolution, it offers significant new elements while maintaining the band's core identity, notably through the predominant use of distorted strings and guitar, marking an interesting evolution for their electronic, drums, and rap sound. "Al fin tenemos Gear of the Sneech de los Z-Grips, llevábamos ya como dos meses el lanzamiento progresivo, estos lanzamientos raros que le gustan tanto la banda."
